tagline.value: Surf, Chill & Feel at Home in Ahangama
tagline.note: the owner's own headline on Hostelworld

description.value: Welcome to your perfect base in Ahangama! Whether you're here to ride the waves or simply unwind, our hostel strikes the ideal balance between social vibes and personal space. Located just a short walk from the famous Kabalana Beach, you'll find a variety of restaurants, surf spots, and cozy hangout areas right at your doorstep.
description.note: verbatim, the owner's own copy on Hostelworld — the best writing this business has anywhere

description_long.value: Why Stay With Us? — Prime Location: 5-minute walk to Kabalana Beach, close to cafes, restaurants & surf schools. Chill & Social Vibes: Mingle when you want, relax when you need. Dorms & Private Rooms: Options for every kind of traveler. Comfort & Convenience: A/C & fan in every room; private lockers & personal fridge in every room; modern bathrooms with hot showers. Extras You'll Love: beautiful green garden & chill zone; free filtered water — refill anytime; daily free healthy breakfast (rotis, fruits, pancakes, eggs — vegan options available); cheap scooter rental (also with surf rack possible); reliable Wi-Fi (fiber internet); laundry service available; 24/7 reception. Family-Run & Heartfelt Hospitality: Our hostel is managed by a local family who are passionate about making you feel at home from the moment you arrive.
description_long.note: verbatim from Hostelworld, lightly joined into one block; bullets preserved as written

run_by.note: the owner's own words; corroborated by many guest reviews calling it family-run

quotes.text: It's the best Hostel I've ever stayed at! I ended up staying 9 days instead of 2 because I didn't want to leave! The rooms are quite spacious and the outdoor bathroom got a roof so its protected but never humid. Overall felt super welcomed by the...
quotes.author: Maximilian, Germany

quotes.text: Lovely location away from the main road. So close to the beach! The most amazing family who look after you like you're one of their own. Thank you KA!
quotes.author: Clara, United Kingdom

quotes.text: The most amazing family running the business and the quiet of the place. :)
quotes.author: Luzzi, France

quotes.text: It's a calm and quiet place, a wonderful staff, caring owners and clean. I had a really good time even i havnt spent much time there. beds are compfy and it has aircon and warm water.
quotes.author: Wolfgang, Austria

quotes.text: Rooms modern, clean and comfortable. Owner friendly and kind. In a really nice location and nice communal area. Highly recommend, would stay again! 😍
quotes.author: Ellen, Ireland

quotes.text: The rooms were super spacious and very nice interior.
quotes.author: Sara, Switzerland

quotes.text: The family is so so so friendly , they are personal and care for everybody like you are one of their children. They are kind hearted honest people
quotes.author: Nanet, Netherlands

quotes.text: Great family owned hostel :-) they are really friendly and helpful! The breakfast always consists of a typical Sri Lankan dish (roti, hoppers,…) which changes every day and additionally a great fruit platter!! Dorms are big, bathrooms are nice with the whole outdoor thing :-)
quotes.author: Elena, Female, 25-30, Germany

quotes.text: Owners very hospitable, breakfast in the morning was great, close to kabalana beach so great for surfing
quotes.author: Saketh, Male, 18-24, England

quotes.text: I got dengue in Kandy and the staff at KA helped nurse me back to health with Ayurvedic medicines (on top of what the hospital was already giving me) They are the kindest people and they attract good vibes. I met some of the best people here :)
quotes.author: Mia, Female, 18-24, USA

existing_site.notes: no website of its own. The business's entire web identity is rented: Booking.com, Hostelworld, Agoda, TripAdvisor and an Instagram account with 1,494 followers and a one-line bio ('Best for who interested surfing'). The good copy and the good photos all live on platforms that take a commission.

gaps.why: nightly rates are live, dated inventory on the OTAs, not a published price list; they cannot be captured as a static fact
no site of its own; every booking pays an OTA commission
a hostel with 24-hour reception publishes no hours for the restaurant side, although Google's name includes 'and restaurant'
Google's listing name says 'and restaurant' but no OTA mentions a restaurant, and no menu or food offer is published anywhere
listing exists but TripAdvisor 403s this harvester
usable but modest: 576–1024 px on Booking, 640 px on Instagram. Photography on location would beat all of it

contradictions.what: Parking: Booking.com says 'No parking available'; Hostelworld lists 'Free Parking'.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — ask the owner. Do not publish either claim.

contradictions.what: Check-in: Booking.com says check-in and check-out are 'available 24 hours'; Hostelworld says check-in 13:00–23:00, check-out until 13:00.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — ask the owner. Hostelworld's specific window is the more likely truth.

contradictions.what: WiFi: the owner advertises 'Reliable Wi-Fi (Fiber Internet)'; Booking.com guests score Free WiFi 2.5/10.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved, and material — do not repeat the fiber claim on the new site without checking.

contradictions.what: Name: Google's listing is 'KA surf hostel and restaurant'; every OTA and the Instagram account say only 'KA Surf Hostel'.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — ask whether the restaurant still operates.
